mechanism_narrative: The sharp drop in WORKPLACES over the last two weeks reduces weekday trips and spillover errands, so RETAIL_REC will keep falling over the next four weeks as commuting-linked shopping weakens further.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above its last-4-week mean for the next 28 days despite WORKPLACES staying below -30 percent for most weeks.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT falls below -40 percent from baseline, access friction becomes binding and suppresses discretionary retail visits within one to two weeks, pushing RETAIL_REC lower.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline within 14 days after TRANSIT crosses below -40 percent and stays there.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of higher RESIDENTIAL time and lower WORKPLACES indicates substitution toward staying home, which reduces spontaneous shopping trips and lowers RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not underperform its prior 4-week average when RESIDENTIAL rises while WORKPLACES falls for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in PARKS mobility absorbs discretionary out-of-home time and competes with shopping outings, so RETAIL_REC weakens over the next one to two weeks when park use stays elevated.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall within 7 days after PARKS moves above 50 percent and remains elevated.

mechanism_narrative: If GROCERY_PHARM falls while WORKPLACES falls at the same time, routine trip bundling collapses and retail visits decline over the following four weeks rather than rebounding.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 28 days even though both GROCERY_PHARM and WORKPLACES remain below their last-4-week means.

mechanism_narrative: A further week-on-week deterioration in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES signals renewed access constraints, and retail mobility will track that shock downward within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both fall by at least 5 points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline within 14 days after both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES fall by at least 5 points in the same week.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL stays above +4 percent while PARKS remain elevated, people reallocate time away from shopping toward home-based and outdoor leisure, keeping RETAIL_REC below its recent average over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above the prior 4-week mean despite RESIDENTIAL staying above +4 percent and PARKS staying elevated for most of the next month.

mechanism_narrative: In a reopening regime, a partial recovery in TRANSIT combined with stabilization in WORKPLACES restores commuting-linked shopping trips, so RETAIL_REC turns upward over the next month.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains below its last-4-week mean for 28 days even though TRANSIT improves and WORKPLACES stops falling.
